# SlideShare France

> > SlideShare France hosts professional presentations and documents covering technology, telecommunications, quality management, and content curation topics.

This French-language platform features educational presentations and PDF documents on diverse professional subjects including LTE/4G mobile networks, AMDEC quality methodology, data warehouse architecture, and digital content curation tools. Content is shared by professionals and experts across various technical and business domains.

## Key Topics

- SlideShare
- LTE (Long Term Evolution)
- 4G mobile networks
- AMDEC (failure analysis)
- Data warehouse design
- Scoop.it
- Content curation
- Telecommunications
- Quality management
- Risk analysis
- Wireless technology
- Star schema modeling
- Veille (monitoring)
- Professional presentations

## Telecommunications & Mobile Networks

- [long term evolution Lte 4g](https://fr.slideshare.net/iamabdo1/long-term-evolution-lte-4g): LTE/4G mobile network technology overview presentation with specs

## Quality Management & Methodology

- [Amdec](https://fr.slideshare.net/EXPERTPLUS/amdec): AMDEC quality management methodology guide for failure analysis

## Data & Business Intelligence

- [Conception datawarehouse](https://fr.slideshare.net/DkhissiHassane/conception-datawarehouse): Data warehouse design concepts with star and snowflake modeling techniques

## Content Curation & Digital Tools

- [Créer un Scoop.it pour partager une veille](https://fr.slideshare.net/lepagegilles/crer-un-scoopit-pour-partager-une-veille): Tutorial on creating and using Scoop.it for content curation and sharing
